from datetime import datetime

# login
phone_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone')
venmo_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo')
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='7763361246', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# resolve Cory contacts
cory_contacts=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Cory', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    cory_contacts.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('cory_contacts_total', len(cory_contacts))
# map each phone contact to venmo user by searching email
mapped_emails=set()
map_details=[]
for c in cory_contacts:
    email = c.get('email')
    if not email:
        continue
    # search venmo users by email
    results=[]
    pidx=0
    while True:
        res_page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=pidx, page_limit=20)
        if not res_page:
            break
        results.extend(res_page)
        pidx += 1
    if results:
        for u in results:
            mapped_emails.add(u.get('email'))
        map_details.append((c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), email, [r.get('email') for r in results]))

print('mapped_emails_count', len(mapped_emails))
print('mapped_emails_sample', list(mapped_emails)[:10])
print('map_details_count', len(map_details))
for item in map_details[:5]:
    print(item)
